_comment: Authoritative mirror list for the resilience service worker (sw.js). Only entries with enabled:true and a non-empty url are used. Canonical origin (cruxcoach.org) is intentionally NOT listed here. codeberg.page slot removed 2026-07-08 (it 307-redirects to the custom domain, useless as a mirror); Disroot removed (no pages hosting). 2026-08-05: added mirror.cruxcoach.org after the apex was 502 for a day — a mirror we operate ourselves is the only one we can repair. github-pages stays enabled ONLY until the apex moves to GitHub Pages; at that moment cruxcoach.github.io starts 301-ing to the apex and must be disabled, or the mirror resolves to the very origin it exists to survive.

mirrors.note: Our own host (Hetzner, same box as stats./blossom.), Caddy site block in cruxcoach-dlstats/deploy/caddy/Caddyfile serving the nightly checkout with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Independent infrastructure from both Codeberg and GitHub.
GitHub Pages mirror (repo CruxCoach/CruxCoach.github.io, synced nightly by cron-refresh.sh). Verified 2026-07-08: serves the site at root with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Planned nsite (Nostr+Blossom) gateway URL, e.g. https://<npub>.nsite.lol — fill once published via nsyte.
Planned IPFS gateway URL for the pinned CID — fill once pinned (Filebase free tier) and _dnslink TXT is set.
